title: Execution targets and rebind
summary: Frozen targets and digests stay as provenance across authorized takeover and never gate a write. Current execution ownership, same-target ancestry, tenant/project/member or shared-group authority and endpoint checks remain required. QA tests whatever is deployed: QA start reports a different served commit and proceeds, and every deployment-bound browser case records the commit its environment served at case start. Once the successor has a ready deploy receipt, execution and mission views name its pinned release_version, and command cases check out the current owning run's project source. A takeover tells each moved member owner once that QA moved to the successor and opens at its item QA stage; the predecessor wake is not the command. An inherited fail whose merge is in the current release retries with yoke qa plan run --item REF --stage STAGE --project SLUG. A takeover is never a reason to rebind a target. Neither observation changes nor early verdicts grant release approval.
